ITEM 1 | Pale green leafy pieces with creamy white dressing coating, sitting in a loose mound on the upper part of the plate; leaves are wilted-looking, sliced into strips about 3-5 cm long, moist and glossy where dressed | 110
ITEM 2 | Thin, pale ivory shaved or sliced hard cheese curls, flat and translucent-edged, draped over the upper leafy mound; roughly 6-8 cm long pieces with slightly matte surface | 15
ITEM 3 | Creamy white dressing or sauce clinging to the leaves and pooling lightly between them, thick and opaque, with a smooth sheen | 25
ITEM 4 | Small cubes and chunks of pale golden-brown breaded or seared meat-like pieces, about 2-3 cm each, with slightly crisp edges, scattered in the upper right area among the greens | 60
ITEM 5 | Halved and quartered brussels sprouts, dark green with charred, blackened outer leaves and browned cut faces, about 3-4 cm across, glossy with light oil, lower left of plate | 90
ITEM 6 | Yellow squash or zucchini pieces, sliced into rounds and half-moons about 1-2 cm thick, golden-yellow with light browning on edges, moist and tender-looking, lower center | 45
ITEM 7 | Light brown grain mixture with small orange-tinged bits and flecks of green, loose and slightly moist, spread in a mound at the lower right edge, with a few dark reddish leaf pieces mixed in | 85
